points.cn: 委托与授权 → 范围与报价 → 100% 预付

cards.title_cn: 订阅制咨询成果，不增加编制
cards.sub_cn: 调研、分析、文档与演示，按成果交付
cards.sub_en: Research, analysis, documents, and decks—delivered as finished work.

points.cn: 按月订阅，按成果验收
points.en: Monthly subscription; you accept the deliverable.

points.cn: 调研、分析、文档、演示，按需订购
points.en: Research, analysis, documents, decks—ordered as needed.

points.cn: 不增加编制，不涉及劳务派遣
points.en: No added headcount and no labor dispatch.

cards.quote_cn: 增设岗位是固定成本，业务量不是。
cards.quote_en: Hiring is a fixed cost. Volume is not.

cards.title_cn: 你的客户问：这家工厂靠谱吗？
cards.title_en: Your client asks: is this factory reliable?
cards.sub_cn: 律所、保险、货代、商会：把 CSCV 放进尽职调查
cards.sub_en: For law firms, insurers, forwarders, and chambers: add CSCV to due diligence.

points.cn: 单边收费；不收被核验方费用、返点或礼品
points.en: One-sided fee; no fee, rebate, or gift from the subject.

points.cn: 方法不披露；到访只给时间窗
points.en: Method undisclosed; a visit window, not a date.

points.cn: 不认证、不撮合、不担保
points.en: No certification, no matchmaking, no guarantee.

cards.headline_cn: 在中国现场核验供应商，只向买方收费
cards.headline_en: On-site supplier verification in China, paid only by the buyer.

points.cn: 负责方案设计与签发
points.en: Owns solution design and final sign-off.

points.cn: 主导工厂同意书谈判，取得现场权限
points.en: Leads consent talks that turn cooperation into site access.

points.cn: 解释核验边界：哪些能核验、哪些不能
points.en: Explains what verification can and cannot check.

cards.headline_cn: 广东与周边省份现场核验，证据而不是意见
cards.headline_en: On-site checks in Guangdong, evidence over opinions.

points.cn: 统一清单：主体、场地、产能、记录
points.en: One checklist: entity, site, capacity, records.

points.cn: 带定位与时间戳的照片与访谈记录
points.en: Geo-tagged, time-stamped photos and interview notes.

points.cn: 逐条写出未核验项与原因
points.en: Writes down every unverified item and why.

cards.headline_cn: 在付款前，把供应商问题问清楚
cards.headline_en: Getting the supplier question settled before payment.

points.cn: 首次沟通 15 分钟，只要三样信息
points.en: The first call takes 15 minutes and three items.

points.cn: 供应商名称、产品与订单金额
points.en: Supplier name, product, and order value.

points.cn: 24 小时内回复可行性、报价与交付日期
points.en: A reply within 24 hours: feasibility, price, delivery date.

cards.headline_cn: 中国供应商独立核验，证据可复核
cards.headline_en: Independent China supplier verification, evidence you can re-check.
